A Druid spell of tier 1, school line druid_wild. Flings a barbed vine at a foe: its damage nature damage and a short slow.
A Druid spell of tier 1, school line druid_grove. A bead of cool dew heals the one you look at (yourself if none): its healing health.
A Druid spell of tier 2, school line druid_wild. Briars burst from the ground at the target spot and hold anything in them: slow and light damage each pulse.
A Druid spell of tier 2, school line druid_grove. Your skin takes on oak bark for 12 seconds: resistance, at the cost of slowness.
A Druid spell of tier 3, school line druid_grove. A ring of green light heals you and every ally close by, and leaves a slow regrowth.
A Druid spell of tier 3, school line druid_wild. You bound forward and up like a stag and take no damage from the fall that follows.
A Druid spell of tier 4, school line druid_wild. Hold to draw a white-berried spear of pith and thorn. A full draw pierces two foes and poisons them.

The grove-keepers. They mend the hurt and bind the loud with root and thorn. Heals and plant control. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Draeid made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.
A staff of the Draeid way. Adds spell power and carries the school's first spell. Crafted with a bronze ingot and 1 moss block. Age III.
The greater staff of the Draeid way: more spell power and 300 uses. Crafted with a steel ingot and 2 moss block. Age V.
A Ovate spell of tier 1, school line ovate_omen. A bright flicker that stings for its damage and leaves the target outlined for 6 seconds.
A Ovate spell of tier 1, school line ovate_sight. Your eyes open to the dark for 40 seconds: night vision.
A Ovate spell of tier 2, school line ovate_omen. You pull on the target's thread: it is weakened and slowed for 8 seconds and takes its damage.
A Ovate spell of tier 2, school line ovate_sight. You step through the veil and appear 8 blocks ahead.
A Ovate spell of tier 3, school line ovate_omen. Channel for 2.5 seconds: a stream of bright knowing cuts through everything in a line.
A Ovate spell of tier 3, school line ovate_sight. Everything hostile within 14 blocks glows for 10 seconds, even behind stone.
A Ovate spell of tier 4, school line ovate_omen. You name a place and the blow falls there a heartbeat later: its damage to everything in 3 blocks.

The seers. They see what is hidden and strike where a blow is already foretold. Sight, marks and blinks. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Fiusaichi made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.
A staff of the Fiusaichi way. Adds spell power and carries the school's first spell. Crafted with a bronze ingot and 1 amethyst shard. Age III.
The greater staff of the Fiusaichi way: more spell power and 300 uses. Crafted with a steel ingot and 2 amethyst shard. Age V.
A Bard spell of tier 1, school line bard_thunder. One struck note travels as a crackle and does its damage.
A Bard spell of tier 1, school line bard_strain. The target's limbs go heavy: slowness and weakness for 6 seconds, and it forgets its hurry.
A Bard spell of tier 2, school line bard_strain. A long falling strain: nearby foes stagger back and are struck by dread: nausea for 4 seconds.
A Bard spell of tier 2, school line bard_strain. A bright strain mends you and each ally near you for its healing and quickens them for 4 seconds.
A Bard spell of tier 3, school line bard_thunder. A great horn blast hammers the area in front of you: its damage and a heavy shove.
A Bard spell of tier 3, school line bard_strain. A marching song for 15 seconds: you and nearby allies gain speed and haste.
A Bard spell of tier 4, school line bard_thunder. Hold a chord for 3 seconds. The sky answers along your aim and each moment of the chord strikes.

The singers. Three strains (sleep, lament, laughter) and their thunder. Crowd control and rally. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Bàrdu made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.
A staff of the Bàrdu way. Adds spell power and carries the school's first spell. Crafted with a bronze ingot and 1 bell. Age III.
The greater staff of the Bàrdu way: more spell power and 300 uses. Crafted with a steel ingot and 2 bell. Age V.
A Filid spell of tier 1, school line filid_satire. A hard line of verse flies out: its damage and a short weakness.
A Filid spell of tier 1, school line filid_word. A spoken ward gives you a shield of 3 extra hearts for 20 seconds.
A Filid spell of tier 2, school line filid_satire. A cutting rhyme raises blisters on the proud: slowness, weakness and its damage to the target.
A Filid spell of tier 2, school line filid_word. A true word spoken over you and your allies strips slowing and harmful effects and heals its healing.
A Filid spell of tier 3, school line filid_satire. A rapid recital: five small bolts fan out in a spread, each doing its damage.
A Filid spell of tier 3, school line filid_word. You lay a ban on the target: withering for 5 seconds and hunger for 15.
A Filid spell of tier 4, school line filid_satire. A dark cloud of ill words settles on the target ground for 7 seconds and keeps cursing what stands in it.

The poets of law and satire. Their words wound, bind and shield. Curses, wards and cleansing. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Filid made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.
A staff of the Filid way. Adds spell power and carries the school's first spell. Crafted with a bronze ingot and 1 ink sac. Age III.
The greater staff of the Filid way: more spell power and 300 uses. Crafted with a steel ingot and 2 ink sac. Age V.
A Raven spell of tier 1, school line fitech_terror. Two quick strikes, like a crow at carrion. Each hits for its damage.
A Raven spell of tier 1, school line fitech_battle. A raven-throated shout: you and allies near you gain strength for 10 seconds.
A Raven spell of tier 2, school line fitech_battle. You throw yourself forward in a low leap with a speed burst.
A Raven spell of tier 2, school line fitech_battle. You fall into fury for 8 seconds: strong blows, but you take more harm (weaker defence).
A Raven spell of tier 3, school line fitech_terror. A full spin: three sweeping cuts that hit everything around you for its damage each.
A Raven spell of tier 3, school line fitech_terror. Dread shakes nearby foes: they are shoved back and weakened for 6 seconds.
A Raven spell of tier 4, school line fitech_terror. A single heavy stroke. Foes under a third of their health take triple damage.

The war-crow's way. Short sharp melee strikes, battle shouts and fear. Scales with melee power. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Fitech made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.
A staff of the Fitech way. Adds spell power and carries the school's first spell. Crafted with a bronze ingot and 1 feather. Age III.
The greater staff of the Fitech way: more spell power and 300 uses. Crafted with a steel ingot and 2 feather. Age V.
A Otherworld spell of tier 1, school line sidhe_frost. A cold white mist rises where you point: it clings, slows and nips for 6 seconds.
A Otherworld spell of tier 1, school line sidhe_glamour. A veil of glamour: you are unseen for 6 seconds and quick for 3.
A Otherworld spell of tier 2, school line sidhe_glamour. You step inside the hill and out again 12 blocks ahead.
A Otherworld spell of tier 2, school line sidhe_glamour. A gift from the hill: the target regains its healing health over 10 seconds, and is lightly shielded.
A Otherworld spell of tier 3, school line sidhe_frost. A bright branch flies out and passes through two foes. Each is chilled and takes its damage.
A Otherworld spell of tier 3, school line sidhe_frost. Time thickens around you: foes within 7 blocks crawl for 3 seconds and are nipped by frost.
A Otherworld spell of tier 4, school line sidhe_frost. A hail of stones falls around the target spot: its damage to each foe struck, with a chill.

The hollow-hill folk. Mist, glamour and gifts that come with a price. Control and mobility. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Sìtichi made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.
A staff of the Sìtichi way. Adds spell power and carries the school's first spell. Crafted with a bronze ingot and 1 prismarine crystals. Age III.
The greater staff of the Sìtichi way: more spell power and 300 uses. Crafted with a steel ingot and 2 prismarine crystals. Age V.
A Smith spell of tier 1, school line smith_fire. A spark spits from the fire: its damage and burning for 3 seconds.
A Smith spell of tier 1, school line smith_temper. You plunge your hands in the quench-trough: fire resistance for 40 seconds and any fire on you goes out.
A Smith spell of tier 2, school line smith_fire. Hold to heat the iron. A full draw hurls a white-hot bolt that does its damage and sets the foe alight.
A Smith spell of tier 2, school line smith_temper. You temper your body for 10 seconds: haste, strength and resistance, then a short tiredness.
A Smith spell of tier 3, school line smith_fire. A cloud of hot slag settles at the target spot for 6 seconds and keeps burning what stands in it.
A Smith spell of tier 3, school line smith_fire. Channel the bellows for 2.5 seconds: a lance of heat along your aim, burning all it crosses.
A Smith spell of tier 4, school line smith_fire. A rain of molten iron falls around the target spot: its damage to each drop's blast and burning.

The forge-masters. Fire from the hearth: sparks, hot iron and the long pour. Damage over time and self-tempering. Seven spells from Age III to Age V; learn them from a Liebur Gouba made at the spell binding table or from scrolls found in old chambers.
A staff of the Gouba way. Adds spell power and carries the school's first spell. Crafted with a bronze ingot and 1 blaze powder. Age III.
The greater staff of the Gouba way: more spell power and 300 uses. Crafted with a steel ingot and 2 blaze powder. Age V.
